verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a marketing-automation platform, but the evidence only describes Klaviyo as a hosted SaaS reached through accounts, pricing tiers, and cloud APIs. Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The option to run the MCP server locally is an adjacent tool, not self-hosting of Klaviyo itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
